metadata.description: Eighteen-item parent or teacher rating scale for childhood ADHD symptoms.
metadata.intended_use: Multi-informant screening and symptom assessment in clinical and school contexts.
metadata.name_origin: ADHD Rating Scale, fourth edition, abbreviated ADHD-RS-IV.
metadata.development_history: Designed to map childhood ADHD symptoms to diagnostic symptom domains using parent and teacher ratings.
metadata.measurement_rationale: Separate inattention and hyperactivity/impulsivity ratings support cross-setting assessment.
metadata.interpretation_notes: Ratings are one part of diagnosis and must be combined with developmental history, impairment, and differential assessment.

versions.source_citation: DuPaul et al. (1998). ADHD Rating Scale-IV; German reference edition.

source_documents.title: ADHD Rating Scale-IV German reference
